description:
One proposal in full: the tally against all three gates it must clear, the window timeline, what `conclude` would decide now, and whether you have voted.

Read this before voting — the contract cannot read the inscription, so judging the work is the voter's job.

Reads only.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

era.description: Which legion deployment to read: 1 (live, default). Proposal ids restart at 1 each era, so an id alone is ambiguous.
